title: Using Power Automate for Business Central SFTP
summary: Using Power Automate for Business Central SFTP handles file uploads by creating a table with BLOB storage, an API page for integration, and a Power Automate flow that retrieves files from SFTP servers and stores them in Business Central for processing.
key_points: Create a table with BLOB field to store file content and supporting pages for UI management
Build an API page with System ID and ODataKeyFields to enable Power Automate to interact with the table
Use Power Automate to retrieve SFTP files and post them to Business Central via the API in two steps: create record then upload file content
The approach also works in reverse to push Business Central documents to SFTP servers using Business Events
Downloaded files can be processed by existing delimited data parsers within Business Central

quotes.text: For this example, we are going to use Power Automate.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes Power Automate as the external service for handling SFTP communication outside Business Central's AL code space
